decisive_items: Positive for IgG autoantibodies to envoplakin (210 kDa) and periplakin (190 kDa)
Skin biopsy revealed spongiosis and numerous neutrophils with nuclear dust in the epidermis and superficial perivascular dermatitis with predominant infiltration of lymphocytes in the dermis
response.rationale: The clinical, histopathologic, and especially the immunoblotting findings (anti-envoplakin and anti-periplakin antibodies) are diagnostic of paraneoplastic pemphigus. R3 is a broader category but less specific.

rejected.why: Negative DIF and negative anti-Dsg1/Dsg3 rule out pemphigus vulgaris.
Negative DIF and absence of basement membrane zone antibodies make mucous membrane pemphigoid unlikely.
Although correct as a broad category, it is less specific than R4 and does not capture the definitive serologic findings.
